title: David J Probable NDE 5095
content: This is my amazing NDE. In my late twenties, I was in the neurological intensive care unit section of the hospital for bleeding in the brain. I told the nurse, 'I need to see a doctor, something's worse; this is the worst I've ever felt in my life!' She told me, 'I think you're just having an anxiety attack,' and left the room. I knew she was wrong. All of a sudden, I saw three men in white robes, which looked like they were on fire with a one-inch flame around their bodies standing at the front and sides of my bed. I was terrified because I wanted to help put the fire out but I did not know where the fire extinguisher was! I realized these guys were not even in pain or distress, and I thought, 'Wow, this is really strange.' Then I looked at the fire and I realized it was brighter than a thousand suns but you could stare at it and it did not hurt your eyes, yet it did not lighten up the corners of the hospital room. Although I did not recognize their faces, it was if I had known them my whole life and we were good friends. Then, the one on my left put both hands in the air, and I left my body. We floated straight up through the ceiling face first, which I thought might be painful but it did not hurt at all. We went through the hospital roof and started to ascend into the sky. I turned my body around face down and saw the roof of the building from the perspective of the sky. My view was later confirmed to be true from satellite imagery of the hospital, which proves this was neither a dream not a hallucination. I looked at the grass and the color was different. It was extra vibrant, glowing and pulsating and it was like a feast for the eyes. This is the best I can describe it because the English language does not have the right words. With one angel in front and two on the side, we went up high in the clouds. Then, we started moving horizontally going faster than an airplane, and they did not need wings to fly. I thought to myself, 'Shouldn't friction be causing me pain from wind pressure?' The angel in front spoke without using his mouth. He stated 'There's no friction here.' I said mind-to-mind, 'Why isn't gravity making me fall?' He replied 'There's no gravity here.' I remembered learning that temperature in the clouds is extremely cold and I thought, 'Why aren't I cold?' 'There's no cold here,' was the response. I started to think about my job and university and the angel told me 'THERE'S NO STRESS HERE!' I asked, 'Why aren't we talking with our mouths?' He responded 'On earth, talking with your mouth makes your throat dry.' Then, I said to him, 'I'm glad you speak English, how many languages do you speak?' He said, 'All of them.' I told him I wanted to ask some others things. I asked him what the meaning of life is. He told me 'For the entertainment of the spirit realm.' I asked him when the world will end and as a messenger of God he told me the answer, yet he mentioned there would be some things I would not be allowed to remember and this was be one of them. This whole time we were flying and all of a sudden we started doing acrobatics and we flew straight through a cloud and it was exhilarating. The most fun I'd ever had. It is kind of like being on a rollercoaster and you go over a hill and you get that 'wheeeee' feeling - multiply that by a thousand. Flying through a cloud is like being kissed by a marshmallow. It's the best I know how to describe it. It is so awesome and cool. Next, the angel in front turned around in slow motion facing towards me and all four us stopped in midair. He said 'We have to back.' I said 'NO! This is so cool and I want to feel like this FOREVER!' I pleaded with him 'I do not have any children and I am not married, no one down there needs me!' I said. 'The brain I have down there is injured I don't want to go back to that body, I'd like to stay here.' I was told by him, 'You will be made whole.' After that, I was given a life review. I went back in time to when I was a baby and in my mother's arms. I was happy and loved without any stress, then I looked at my mother and instead of it being her somehow I knew it was God, and He held me in his arms and hugged me and the love I felt was unlike anything on earth. It was perfect because the One I was with has no sin. It brings a tear to my eye because I long for God's hug again, it was the most amazing thing ever and I get homesick! I was not allowed to remember what God looks like. Next, I was shown when I was five years old playing in the sandbox all alone talking to God in an audible voice telling Him my hopes and dreams. I was told by the angel that God absolutely loves it when a child talks to Him! Next, I was shown my sales job as a young adult misleading a customer to make the sale. The angel revealed to me that the demons in hell rejoice when someone tells a lie. All of a sudden, I was in my mother's home, and I saw my mom on the couch crying uncontrollably which I had never seen before in my life. Then, in less than a second, we were transported to my best friend's house, ten miles away and I witnessed her shaking and crying violently which I never witnessed. Apparently, this was a vision of the future had I been allowed to stay and they would be mourning my death, so I told the angel 'Okay, okay, I'll go back.' Instantaneously, I was back in my body. Heaven is real! I was there!

arrival.other_being_detail: Three men in white robes with a one-inch flame around their bodies; later described as angels; one described as a messenger of God.

environment.environment_other_detail: Flying through clouds; grass seen from above was extra vibrant, glowing and pulsating.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bleeding in the brain; in neurological intensive care unit.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Future-vision of mother and best friend mourning his death; mention of demons in hell rejoicing when someone lies.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Encounter with three robed beings/light in hospital room occurred before leaving the body; then flight/communication, then return discussion, then life review, then future-vision prompting agreement to return, then instantaneous return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Three men in white robes surrounded by a one-inch flame that was brighter than a thousand suns but did not light the room; detailed physics-negation dialogue (no friction/gravity/cold/stress); acrobatic flying through clouds described as exhilarating; future-vision of loved ones mourning; explicit mention that some knowledge was not allowed to be remembered (world end date; God's appearance).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “There's no friction here.” “There's no gravity here.” “There's no cold here.” “THERE'S NO STRESS HERE!” “For the entertainment of the spirit realm.” “You will be made whole.” “Heaven is real! I was there!”
